title: Positive lower n-density of a finite measure on a set forces finite Hⁿ-measure (Vitali 5r-covering)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on ℝ^P with μ(ℝ^P) < ∞, let A ⊆ ℝ^P be an arbitrary set and let η > 0. Suppose liminf_{r↓0} μ(B_r(x))/(ω_n·rⁿ) ≥ η for every x ∈ A. Here B_r(x) is the open ball, ω_n = unitBallVolume n is the volume of the unit ball of ℝⁿ, and the quotient is computed in [0, ∞] with rⁿ entering through ENNReal.ofReal. Then Hⁿ(A) < ∞, where Hⁿ = μHE[n].
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (A : Set (Euclid P)) (η : ℝ), 0 < η → μ univ < ∞ → (∀ x ∈ A, ENNReal.ofReal η ≤ liminf (fun r : ℝ => μ (ball x r) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0)) → μHE[n] A < ∞
